entries.title: Janus alien astronomer and observatory telescope
entries.creator: Janus Observatory project; modeled with OpenAI Codex and Blender
entries.requiredCreditText: Original Janus Observatory alien astronomer and telescope, created for this project with OpenAI Codex and Blender.
entries.aiAssistanceDisclosure: Procedurally modeled with OpenAI Codex and rendered/exported with Blender 5.2.
transformations: Authored as original procedural meshes and PBR materials in Blender 5.2, then exported to binary glTF without external textures or runtime compression.
notes: Interpretive fictional visualization; it is not a Project Janus research artifact or a proposed real instrument design.
Editable Blender source and the deterministic generation script are retained in assets/sources/original/.
